2. The currency of Bangladesh is the Forint.
3. The currency of China is the Yuan (Renminbi).
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
q.e: Statements marked correct: 3.

q.q: The river Mississippi flows through the city of:
q.e: The river Mississippi flows through the city of New Orleans.

q.q: Windhoek is the capital of:
q.e: Windhoek is the capital of Namibia.

q.q: Which of the following is a UNESCO World Heritage Site in Pakistan?
q.e: Mohenjo-daro is a UNESCO World Heritage Site in Pakistan.

q.q:
Consider the following statements:
1. Doha is the capital of Yemen.
2. Bishkek is the capital of Kyrgyzstan.
3. Phnom Penh is the capital of Cambodia.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
q.e: Statements marked correct: 2, 3.

q.q: The dry dusty wind blowing from the Sahara over West Africa is the:
q.e: The dry dusty wind blowing from the Sahara over West Africa is the Harmattan.

q.q: Which of the following is a country crossed by the Tropic of Cancer?
q.e: Bangladesh is a country crossed by the Tropic of Cancer.

q.q: The only country in the world to border both the Caspian Sea and the Persian Gulf is:
q.e: The only country in the world to border both the Caspian Sea and the Persian Gulf is Iran.

q.q:
Consider the following statements:
1. The river that drains into the Laptev Sea is the Columbia.
2. The river that drains into the Indian Ocean is the Zambezi.
3. The river that drains into the Gulf of Guinea is the Irrawaddy.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
q.e: Statements marked correct: 2.

q.q: Which of the following is NOT a country crossed by the Tropic of Cancer?
q.e: Iran is not a country crossed by the Tropic of Cancer.

q.q: The present ages of A and B are in the ratio 2:1. After 5 years the ratio will be 7:4. What is the sum of their present ages?
A boat's speed in still water is 10 km/h and the stream flows at 5 km/h. It goes a certain distance downstream and returns to the starting point in 24 hours. What is that one-way distance (km)?
The mean of 25 observations was found to be 47. Later it was discovered that one observation was wrongly read as 16 instead of 48. The correct mean is:
q.e: Correct total = 1175 − 16 + 48; mean = 48.28.

q.q: A man walking at 10 km/h reaches his office 20 minutes late, while walking at 15 km/h he reaches 30 minutes early. The distance to his office (km) is:
A point P is 25 cm from the centre of a circle of radius 7 cm. The length of the tangent from P to the circle is:
A function satisfies f(x) + 3·f(1/x) = 4x + 4/x for all x ≠ 0. The value of f(3) is:
q.e: Write the relation for x and 1/x, then eliminate f(1/x): f(3) = 3 1/3.

q.q: A, B and C can finish a job alone in 20, 60 and 15 days respectively. They start together, but C leaves after 3 days. In how many days in all is the job completed?
q.e: Work in 3 days = 0.4; remaining by A and B at 1/15/day takes 9 days; total 12.

q.q: The highest power of 3 that divides 150! is 3^k. Then k equals:
q.e: Legendre's formula: Σ⌊150/3^i⌋ = 72.

q.q: The smallest number which leaves a remainder of 2 when divided by 9, 6 and 12, and is exactly divisible by 11, is:
q.e: x = 36m + 2; choose the least m with x divisible by 11: 110.

q.q: A regular polygon has 20 sides. The number of its diagonals is:
The units digit of (23^53 × 4^47) + 23^47 is:
q.e: Find each units digit from its cycle: 3×4 + 7 → 9.

q.q: A trader marks his goods 50% above the cost price and allows two successive discounts of 20% and 10%. His profit or loss percentage on the cost price is (a loss is shown as a negative figure):
A committee of 5 is to be chosen from 5 men and 5 women so that it contains at least 1 man and at least 2 women. The number of ways is:
q.e: Add the cases (1 man, 4 women), (2,3), (3,2): 225.

q.q: The area of the triangle with vertices (3, 5), (5, -2) and (1, 3) (in square units) is:
q.e: Area = ½|x₁(y₂−y₃)+x₂(y₃−y₁)+x₃(y₁−y₂)| = 9.

q.q: Which of the following numbers does not belong with the others?  67, 79, 33, 47, 41
q.e: Four of them are prime numbers; 33 is not.

q.q: Find the wrong number in the series: 9, 7, 14, 11, 19, 17, 24
q.e: The correct series (two interleaved series: +5 and +4) has 15 in place of 17.

q.q: Statement: V ≤ X ≤ Y = U < Q ≥ W. Conclusions: I. X > Y  II. U = Q  III. X ≥ U. Which of the conclusions is/are definitely true?
o: Only I and III are true
q.e: A conclusion is definitely true only if it holds for every set of values consistent with the whole chain.

q.q: What is the present age of A? (The ages of A and B are whole numbers of years.) I. A is 26 years old. II. The sum of the ages of A and B is 55 years.
o: Statement II alone is sufficient, but statement I alone is not
Even both statements together are not sufficient
Statement I alone is sufficient, but statement II alone is not
Both statements together are sufficient, but neither alone is
q.e: Test each statement alone, then both together, by checking whether exactly one value of the unknown remains.

q.q: If the letters of the word TREASURE are arranged in alphabetical order (repeated letters counted each time), which letter is 5th from the right?
q.e: Alphabetical order: AEERRSTU.

q.q: After 5 o'clock, at how many minutes past 5 do the hour hand and the minute hand of a clock first make an angle of 90° with each other?
q.e: 5.5m = 30·5 ± 90 (mod 360); the first positive solution is m = 10 10/11 minutes.

q.q: On an island every inhabitant is either a knight (always tells the truth) or a knave (always lies). Sadia says: "Exactly one of Danish and Waqar is a knight." Danish says: "Exactly 2 of the 5 of us are knights." Zainab says: "Sadia and Zainab are of the same type." Waqar says: "Exactly one of Waqar and Zainab is a knight." Hina says: "Danish and Waqar are not both knights." How many of the 5 are knights?
q.e: Test each person as knight/knave; only one assignment makes every statement consistent.

q.q: 6 students Ali, Danish, Kamran, Mariam, Omar, Sara each have a test on a different day, from Monday to Saturday (one test per day). Sara's and Kamran's tests are on consecutive days. Ali's test is neither on the first nor on the last day. Omar's test is on either the first or the last day. Sara's test is held on a day between those of Danish and Kamran. Exactly 3 days separate Ali's test and Omar's. Sara's test is held on the day immediately before Kamran's. Ali's test is held on a day between those of Danish and Kamran. Mariam's test is held earlier in the week than Sara's. On which day is Mariam's test held?
q.e: Place the definite clues first (immediate neighbours, ends), then use the 'between' and 'left of' clues to fix the rest; the arrangement is unique.

q.q: The calendar of the year 2028 will be exactly the same as that of which later year (the first such year)?
q.e: A year with the same first weekday and the same leap-year status first occurs in 2056.

q.q: A solid wooden cube of edge 4 cm has five faces (the bottom face is left unpainted) painted and is then cut into 64 unit cubes. How many of the unit cubes have exactly 3 painted face(s)?
q.e: Classify the unit cubes by position (corners, edges, face centres, interior) and count the painted faces each has.

q.q:
Find the missing number in the third row:
8  3  61
8  4  60
9  8  ?
q.e: The rule is c = a² − b, so the missing number is 73.

q.q: If '+' means '×', '−' means '÷', '×' means '−', '÷' means '+', then the value of 20 × 9 × 9 ÷ 13 is:
q.e: Replace each sign by its meaning: 20 − 9 − 9 + 13 = 15 (BODMAS applies).

q.q: Subscriber Identity Module is the full form of:
q.e: Subscriber Identity Module is the full form of SIM.

q.q: The World Wide Web was proposed by Tim Berners-Lee in:
q.e: The World Wide Web was proposed by Tim Berners-Lee in 1989.

q.q: The big data 'V' that refers to the trustworthiness of data is:
q.e: The big data 'V' that refers to the trustworthiness of data is Veracity.

q.q:
Consider the following statements:
1. The algorithm used for deadlock avoidance is the Banker's algorithm.
2. The Linux command to remove a file is df.
3. The Linux command to run a command as the superuser is cp.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
q.e: Statements marked correct: 1.

q.q: Which of the following is a web browser?
q.e: Edge is a web browser.

q.q: Which of the following is NOT a relational database management system?
q.e: MongoDB is not a relational database management system.

q.q:
Consider the following statements:
1. The full form of UML is Unified Modeling Language.
2. The full form of SDLC is Infrastructure as a Service.
3. The full form of ACID is Atomicity, Consistency, Isolation, Durability.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
q.e: Statements marked correct: 1, 3.

q.q:
Consider the following statements:
1. The IEEE standard for Wi-Fi is 802.16.
2. The device that forwards packets between networks using IP addresses is a Router.
3. The network topology in which every device connects to every other device is the Bus topology.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
q.e: Statements marked correct: 2.

q.q:
Consider the following statements:
1. The full form of POST is Dynamic Random Access Memory.
2. The full form of DRAM is Solid State Drive.
3. The full form of NFC is Basic Input Output System.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
q.e: Statements marked correct: none.

q.q: Serial Advanced Technology Attachment is the full form of:
q.e: Serial Advanced Technology Attachment is the full form of SATA.

q.q: The subnet mask equivalent to the prefix /20 is:
q.e: /20 has 20 network bits = 255.255.240.0.

q.q: The register that holds the address of the next instruction is the:
q.e: The register that holds the address of the next instruction is the Program Counter.
